err_hidden: YouTube hides your subscriber count: make it public in YouTube Studio.
err_auth: The YouTube access code is refused: check it in Settings, on the page of the site's YouTube connector.
err_rate: YouTube has reached its request limit for today.
err_config_key: To follow your statistics, add your YouTube access code in Settings, on the page of the site's YouTube connector. It is free.
err_config_channel: YouTube cannot find this channel: check the channel code in Settings (it starts with UC).
err_config_connector: To follow your statistics, the site needs a YouTube access code. Install what is suggested above, then add your code to it.
suggest_reason: keeps the site's YouTube access code and adds your counts, exact durations and Shorts detection
events_note: Only public live streams and premieres are visible. A private scheduled video cannot be seen with the site's access code: to announce it, write the event yourself.
events_setup_channel: To see your scheduled videos, enter your channel code (it starts with UC) in its settings.
events_setup_connector: To see your scheduled videos and live streams, the site needs a YouTube access code. Install what the YouTube channel page offers, then add your code there.
events_setup_key: To see your scheduled lives, add your YouTube access code in Settings, on the site's YouTube connector page. It is free.
events_setup_refused: The YouTube access code is refused: check it in Settings, on the site's YouTube connector page.
events_setup_update: To see your scheduled videos, update the site's YouTube connector (Modules, Check for updates).
